messages:
Samir G: Quick sync — we need a final dry-run for the catalog launch tomorrow. Main asks: press page freeze, SI demo walkthrough, and staging signoff. Who can own?
Jules L: I can run the press freeze. I'll lock assets by 9am PT. Need confirmation from legal on embargo wording.
Maya R: I'll do SI demo walkthrough with Arjun. Can we get a curated test tenant for them?
Arjun P: Yes. Priya, can platform provision a demo tenant with sample org + SSO by EOD?
Priya S: On it. ETA 4pm PT. Adding checklist items: certs, cloud-marketplace SKU links, redirect rules.
Samir G: Great. Also confirm microsite URL and canonical meta tags. @launch-bot can you create the preview URL and give us the staging host?
launch-bot: Preview environment scheduled. Preview URL: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/launch/179315 — expires in 72h.
Jules L: Perfect. I'll validate meta & opengraph. I'll paste the press snippet once legal approves.
Maya R: SI run-through sequence I'd like: 1) Marketplace procurement flow 2) Onboarding via SSO 3) Dedicated capacity demo 4) Pricing and billing Qs. Arjun — can you mock latency numbers for the demo?
Arjun P: I'll attach a small script. Use this to simulate load:
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY" https://preview.redwood-inference.com/api/generate; done
```
It returns 200/OK with simulated token timings.
deploy-bot: Preview build completed — commit abc123. Staging cutover scheduled at 02:00 UTC tomorrow if no blockers. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/abc123
Samir G: Legal wants embargo note: "Do not publish before 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC". Confirmed? @Jules L please hold.
Jules L: Got it. Also need translations for FR/DE/JP on the landing. Can ops queue localization tasks?
Priya S: Yes, started localization ticket IN-4521. Will push PO review.
Maya R: One more blocker — SI needs sample contract language for joint announcement. Can Partnerships draft a 2-paragraph co-announcement template?
Samir G: I'll draft and drop into the thread by 5pm PT.
Arjun P: FYI: we'll run SI dry-run at 10:30 PT tomorrow. Can everyone be available?
Priya S: 10:30 PT works.
Jules L: I'm free.
launch-bot: Reminder set: SI-dryrun at 2026-03-25 10:30 PT. Attendees: Samir G, Jules L, Maya R, Arjun P, Priya S.
Samir G: :thumbsup: Thanks all — pulling the thread into the runbook. I'll update the calendar invite with preview link and embargo note.
